_comment: winject default targets, shipped with the installer and never edited in place. The targets in use are in C:\AI\.agent\winject-data\targets.json (copied from this file the first time add-target / remove-target runs). type: window | line. title: the whole window title, or title_from_config: a key of C:\AI\.agent\config.json read at send time.

agent.note: this computer's AI window (its title is config.json agent_name)
